description: Change of use of the outbuilding to use as a beauty salon (Use class E) (retrospective)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal;">The premises
shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other
purpose, including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and
Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to
that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with
or without modification).<o:p></o:p></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be retained in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:  3317-P-010; 3317-P-001; Site Plan; Letter from MZA planning dated 29h August 2025.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal;">The use hereby
permitted shall be by appointment only and shall not be open to customers
outside the following times:-&nbsp; 11:00 hours to 13:00 hours and 15:00 hours
to 19:00 hours &nbsp;Monday to Saturday, with
no operation on Sundays and Bank holidays, without the prior written permission
of the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal;">Within three months of the date of this permission, the use of the front rooms of the dwellinghouse as a beauty salon must cease to operate and the rooms should be fully reinstated to residential use ancillary to the main dwellinghouse at no.2 Waverley Road, Rayners Lane, Harrow, HA2 9RB.<o:p></o:p></p>
